article_title: Pathways Unlocked: A Learner-Centered Toolkit for Usable Learning & Employment Record Technologies
citation: Digital Promise. (2025). Pathways Unlocked: A Learner-Centered Toolkit for Usable Learning & Employment Record Technologies. https://digitalpromise.org
title: Six best practices for embedding IUX across the LER project lifecycle
description: The toolkit enumerates six best practices: define inclusivity and accessibility goals early, incorporate research and user empathy early on, test and validate with learners on an ongoing basis, utilize established inclusive design principles, follow up with continuous improvement, and collaborate with a diverse project team and partners. It states that "Embedding IUX early saves time and improves outcomes by addressing barriers related to ability, background, and access." The practices span planning, development, testing, and post-launch improvement.
requirements: Goals should align with the identified needs of the intended learner audience
target_learners: project teams designing or implementing LER technologies for diverse learners and workers
target_learning_goals: accessible, authentic, and practical LER technology design
examples: The IUX Integration Planning Template operationalizes the practices across six practice areas with intent, actions, involvement, and measures of success
key_sources: Digital Promise. (2025). Pathways Unlocked: A Learner-Centered Toolkit for Usable Learning & Employment Record Technologies. https://digitalpromise.dspacedirect.org/items/2a540607-a680-4548-8524-80af4924d62b

article_title: Relational topologies in the learning activity spaces: operationalising a sociomaterial approach
citation: Linda Castañeda, Victoria I. Marín, Daniel Villar-Onrubia. (2024). Relational topologies in the learning activity spaces: operationalising a sociomaterial approach. Education Tech Research Dev. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11423-023-10296-z
title: Decuypere's IUDE toolbox of four topologies of data practices
description: The article draws on Decuypere's (2021) methodological framework of topologies of digital data practices, defined as "the actions, performances, and the resulting consequences of introducing data-producing technologies in everyday situations". Decuypere presents "four topologies of data practices... Interface (on), Usage (with), Design (behind) and Ecology (beyond)", together constituting the IUDE-toolbox. The framework uses topologies as the basic unit of analysis to study the qualitative qualities of relations between actors, and is explicitly non-one-size-fits-all and adaptable.
requirements: Focus on actions and consequences of data-producing technologies rather than the technologies themselves
Use of topologies as the basic unit of analysis
constraints: Presented as a non-one-size-fits-all and adaptable solution
target_learning_goals: Studying digital data practices in educational processes
examples: The article's first topology falls between the user and interface categories as classified by Decuypere
